purpose: Describe doing an action repeatedly or with great intensity.
keywords: I read book after book on my day off.
I got bitten by mosquitoes all over.
I took masses of photos on the trip.
restrictions: Often suggests uncontrolled or enthusiastic repetition.
mistake: It is stronger and more informal than simply たくさん.

segments.role: Describe doing an action repeatedly or with great intensity. Vます stem + まくる
